details: Career Commencement: April’19-December’19 with Capgemini, Pune as Consultant in AML project
Key Result Areas
• Worked proactively in AML Actimize team in American MNC Banking Client for analysis of existing rules for alerts, detection
for Suspicious transaction activity of Capital Markets products
• Involved in demise of old systems and Onboarding of new systems for populating KYC Risk data and customer risk rating
• Proactively involved in data mapping of new vs old systems and having constant interaction with client from Requirement to Documentation to onboarding stage.
• Sole owner/Single point of contact of producing and delivering the BRD for every migration project

projects.name: Project
details: Career Commencement: Nov’15-March’19 with BNY Mellon Technologies Pvt Ltd, Pune as Lead Business Analyst in Financial
Management Domain
Key Result Areas
• Spearheading end-to-end solution for integrating the central bank with the vendor by creating a robust & dynamic system
to reconcile end of day data without any fail along with all the financial instruments
• Generating data files by creating a Workflow under the BNY proprietary tool and co-ordinate with multiple stakeholders to provide timely delivery & validation for every end-of-day data
• Used SQL on a day-to-day basis for the creation of data files and apply logic according to the business requirements
• Also involved briefly with project related to Post Trade Settlement process
